extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (api.tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - 3D films get their own button in the player controls. On a 3D file it sits beside subtitles and audio, and asks the same question the film asks when it starts, so you can change your mind part way through. It replaces the 3D row under Adjust, which applied every mode as you stepped past it and made the television renegotiate the picture on each press. - The Adjust panel is easier to read: a value and its arrows no longer sit tight under the label above them. - "Report a problem" under Settings -> Privacy & About no longer runs off the end of its card. The part that was cut off said where account and server trouble goes instead; the issue page the code opens says it now, where it is a link rather than an address to copy off a television.

extension.summary: Install and update the tofa add-on
extension.description: The update channel for tofa's Kodi add-on. Installing this repository lets Kodi fetch the add-on and every later release on its own.
